Open the council guide.mi: Huakina te aratohu a te kaunihera
Open the council guide.comment: VoiceOver label of the glass safari button, top trailing on the Guide; opens the council's own page for the bin on screen

Booked collection.comment: Small uppercase eyebrow above 'Inorganic Collection' on the Guide: this service is booked, not on a regular schedule

Not in your schedule.comment: Small uppercase eyebrow above a bin's name on the Guide when the council collects this bin but the household has not set it up in its schedule

%@ · %@.comment: Small uppercase eyebrow above a bin's name on the Guide: frequency, then weekday (e.g. 'Weekly · Tuesday'). First %@ is 'Weekly' or 'Fortnightly', second is the weekday name

%@, page %lld of %lld.comment: VoiceOver label of the Guide's page indicator (lid spheres): bin name, current page number, page count. e.g. 'Rubbish, page 1 of 4'

Yes.comment: Small uppercase heading of the column of items that go in this bin (Guide)

No.comment: Small uppercase heading of the column of items that must not go in this bin (Guide)

Next collections.mi: Ngā kohinga e whai ake nei
Next collections.comment: Schedule tab: small uppercase section label above the list of the next six collection dates.

Recycling week.comment: Schedule tab, Next collections row: muted line under the bin list when that date includes the fortnightly recycling collection.

No recycling.comment: Schedule tab, Next collections row: muted line under the bin list when that date is the off week of a fortnightly recycling schedule.

%@ is %@: collections that week may chan.zh-Hans: %@是%@：那一周的收集可能有变动。
%@ is %@: collections that week may chan.mi: Ko %@ te %@: ka rerekē pea ngā kohinga o taua wiki.
%@ is %@: collections that week may chan.ko: %@(%@): 그 주의 수거가 바뀔 수 있습니다.
%@ is %@: collections that week may chan.hi: %@ %@ को है: उस सप्ताह संग्रह बदल सकता है।
%@ is %@: collections that week may chan.comment: Schedule tab, holiday line for councils without a verified holiday rule. First %@ is the public holiday's name, second is its date (e.g. 'Monday 28 December').

Guide.comment: Tab bar label of the third tab: the bin guide (one page per bin). Short noun.

In %d days.comment: Small uppercase eyebrow on Today before the date, when the next collection is two or more days away: 'In 3 days · Friday 13 November'. %d is always 2 or more.

Out tonight.comment: 44 pt verdict on Today the day before a collection: the bins go out tonight.

Nothing tonight.mi: Kāore he mea i tēnei pō
Nothing tonight.comment: 44 pt verdict on Today when no collection is due tomorrow: nothing to put out tonight.

Done for tonight.hi: आज रात के लिए हो गया
Done for tonight.comment: 44 pt verdict on Today after the household has rolled the bins to the kerb.

%@. Put them out tonight..comment: Sentence under the verdict the day before: %@ is the bin list, e.g. 'Recycling, rubbish and food scraps'.

%@. Have them out early..comment: Sentence on the morning of collection day: %@ is the bin list.

%@. Bring them in once they are emptied..mi: %@. Kawea mai ki roto ina whakawāteatia.
%@. Bring them in once they are emptied..hi: %@। खाली होने के बाद इन्हें अंदर ले आएँ।
%@. Bring them in once they are emptied..comment: Sentence on the afternoon of collection day: %@ is the bin list.

Next: %@ on %@..mi: E whai ake nei: %@ i te %@.
Next: %@ on %@..comment: Sentence when the collection is days away: first %@ is the bin list, second is the weekday name, e.g. 'Next: Rubbish on Friday.'

They are at the kerb. Reminders for this.zh-Hans: 垃圾桶已在路边。本次收集的提醒已关闭。
They are at the kerb. Reminders for this.mi: Kei te taha huarahi ngā ipu. Kua weto ngā whakamaharatanga mō tēnei kohinga.
They are at the kerb. Reminders for this.ko: 쓰레기통을 도로변에 내놓았습니다. 이번 수거 알림은 꺼졌습니다.
They are at the kerb. Reminders for this.hi: डिब्बे सड़क किनारे हैं। इस संग्रह के अनुस्मारक बंद हैं।
They are at the kerb. Reminders for this.comment: Sentence after the bins were marked as out at the kerb; the app has cancelled this collection's reminders.

Then %@: %@..comment: Muted line under the bins about the collection after the next: first %@ a full date such as 'Tuesday 17 November', second the bin list.

%@ bins.comment: VoiceOver label of the bin picture: %@ is the bin list, e.g. 'Recycling, rubbish and food scraps bins'.

Swipe right when they are out.mi: Whiua ki matau ina kua puta ki waho
Swipe right when they are out.hi: बाहर रखने के बाद दाईं ओर स्वाइप करें
Swipe right when they are out.comment: VoiceOver hint on the bin picture: swiping right marks the bins as out at the kerb.

Mark bins as out.hi: डिब्बों को बाहर रखा गया चिह्नित करें
Mark bins as out.comment: VoiceOver custom action name: records that the bins are out at the kerb.

Bring the bins back.comment: VoiceOver custom action name and hint on Undo: reverses marking the bins as out.

Undo.comment: Glass button after marking the bins as out; brings them back and restores the reminders.

Turn on reminders.comment: Prominent button on Today when app reminders are switched off; opens Settings.

Allow notifications.comment: Prominent button on Today when iOS notification permission is denied; opens the system settings.

Refresh reminders.comment: Prominent button on Today when the scheduled reminder batch has run out; reschedules.

Reminders paused until %@.mi: Kua whakatārewatia ngā whakamaharatanga tae noa ki %@
Reminders paused until %@.comment: Quiet status line on Today while reminders are paused: %@ is a date such as '16 November'.

Reminders on · %@.comment: Quiet status line on Today when reminders are scheduled: %@ lists the reminder times, e.g. '7 pm and 7 am'.

Opens Settings.comment: VoiceOver hint on the quiet status line: tapping it opens Settings.

The next fortnight.mi: Ngā wiki e rua e whai ake nei
The next fortnight.comment: Schedule tab: small uppercase label at the top, above the scrolling strip of the next fourteen days.
